name: customdomain
description: Connect a custom domain to an app with DNS and HTTPS handled for you, and diagnose one that is not live.

interface.longDescription: Connect a domain you own to your app, check whether it is live, and fix it when it is not. CustomDomain™ works out the DNS records, issues the HTTPS certificate and serves the traffic. Ask in plain words, sign in once, and approve any change that matters before it happens.
defaultPrompt: Why is my domain not live yet?
Set up email records for my domain.
